skill.summary: Generate AI-powered presentations, documents, and social posts using Gamma.app API. Use when user asks to create a presentation, pitch deck, slide deck, document, or social media carousel. Triggers on requests like "create a presentation about X", "make a pitch deck", "generate slides", or "create a Gamma about X".
